calls.detune: Darwin-Prins curve from xraydb.f0('Si', q), f1_chantler, f2_chantler and xraydb.xray.R0 over +/-400 intrinsic widths at 400001 points; FFT autocorrelation; delta = detune*xraydb.darwin_width(fundamental).rocking_theta_fwhm
calls.g1: y*scipy.integrate.quad(lambda x: scipy.special.kv(5/3,x), y, numpy.inf, epsrel=1e-10)
calls.mirror: xraydb.mirror_reflectivity(coating, angle_mrad*1e-3, energy_eV, density=bulk, roughness=0, polarization='s', output='intensity')

notes: Bending-magnet flux is integrated over all vertical angles; there is no vertical aperture, window or slope-error loss.
bandwidth is the xraydb Darwin energy FWHM over the photon energy, the same definition the TypeScript model uses for the flux band.
Orders whose energy exceeds the tabulated mirror range are listed in omittedOrders and left out of the harmonic sum.
Mirrors are an illustrative generic pair, not a real beamline.
